summary: Tested msisdn_historico portability fix. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (portal login regression + historico login for linha & chip, admin add/remove, idempotency, invalid input, 404 on unknown linha, 403 RBAC for non-admin, 401/403 for unauthenticated). Frontend: History button on /linhas opens dialog, adds a number via input+button (toast confirms), lists numbers, removes with confirmation dialog. All UI selectors match spec.

issues: Missing DialogDescription / aria-describedby on Radix DialogContent (a11y warning in console). Minor.

action_items: Optional: add DialogDescription to <DialogContent data-testid='historico-dialog'> to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: portal_login uses tel.endswith(msisdn[-8:]) OR msisdn.endswith(tel[-8:]) - lax match; two different customers whose numbers share last 8 digits could collide within same CPF (unlikely but worth noting).
adicionar_msisdn_historico only validates min 8 digits; no max length / format check.
remover_msisdn_historico returns 200 even if the number was never in historico (silent no-op); consider 404 for better feedback.
server.py is 6133 lines - well over the 700-line guideline; should be modularized.
seed_data_creation: Inserted TEST cliente (CPF 12345678909) + linha + chip with msisdn_historico via pymongo; auto-cleaned in fixture teardown. Also creates a temporary atendente user via /api/auth/register for RBAC tests (cleaned up).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for portability fix lives at /app/backend/tests/test_msisdn_historico.py and is idempotent (safe to rerun). Non-admin role name is 'atendente' (not 'revendedor') per UserRole enum in server.py.
